title: Board compression target
abstention_triggers: if speed forces skip of unresolved conflict
scenario_summary: The board requires a 14% reduction in end-to-end release lead time without changing registered specifications or weakening independent Quality authority.

title: Conflicting success metrics
scenario_summary: Manufacturing rewards throughput, Quality rewards deviation containment, Supply rewards service level, and Clinical rewards database lock speed.

title: No-AI challenge
scenario_summary: A process-excellence team claims workflow redesign and master-data repair could deliver most value without generative AI.

title: Patent-cliff urgency
scenario_summary: A major product loses exclusivity in 19 months, creating pressure to accelerate a new indication and reduce cost of goods.

title: Acquisition integration
scenario_summary: A recently acquired biotech uses incompatible identifiers, cloud tenancy and quality procedures.

title: Prohibited optimization
scenario_summary: Executives prohibit any AI from autonomously changing formulation, specification, clinical eligibility, safety case disposition, batch release or recall decisions.

title: Assay drift
scenario_summary: A potency assay changed reagent lot and instrument firmware; historical comparability is disputed.

title: Compound genealogy collision
scenario_summary: Two acquired compounds share a local code but have different structures and salt forms.

title: Omics cohort bias
scenario_summary: A translational model was trained mainly on one ancestry group and underperforms on another.

title: Preclinical image manipulation concern
scenario_summary: Image metadata suggests duplicated microscopy panels in a CRO report.

title: Unqualified research model
scenario_summary: A discovery model promoted into portfolio decisions has no approved intended-use statement or locked training set.

title: Target-evidence conflict
scenario_summary: Internal experiments and an external licensed dataset disagree on target validation.

title: Protocol-version divergence
scenario_summary: Sites are executing three protocol versions; one country has not approved the latest amendment.

title: Eligibility ambiguity
scenario_summary: A participant meets central-lab criteria but not the local-lab range encoded by the EDC rule.

title: Randomization service outage
scenario_summary: The IRT service was unavailable and emergency kits were assigned using a manual log.

title: Potential unblinding
scenario_summary: A support ticket exposes treatment-arm hints to site personnel.

title: eConsent withdrawal mismatch
scenario_summary: Consent was withdrawn in the eConsent platform but downstream biomarker processing continued.

title: Decentralized-device clock skew
scenario_summary: Wearable devices report timestamps in mixed local time and UTC with daylight-saving errors.

title: Endpoint adjudication backlog
scenario_summary: Imaging endpoint packets contain missing source documents and conflicting reviewer conclusions.

title: Site inspection risk
scenario_summary: A high-enrolling site has unusual data regularity, late source uploads and repeated credential sharing.

title: Biologics batch genealogy break
scenario_summary: A single-use assembly lot is missing from one MES genealogy branch but appears in warehouse consumption.

title: Sterility excursion
scenario_summary: Environmental monitoring shows an excursion near fill-finish; organism identification was corrected after initial review.

title: OOS/OOT disagreement
scenario_summary: LIMS marks an assay OOS, the statistical tool marks it OOT, and the laboratory notebook labels it invalid.

title: Unit conversion defect
scenario_summary: A contract laboratory transmitted concentration in mg/L while the receiving interface assumed µg/mL.

title: Electronic batch record exception
scenario_summary: A required step was completed during network degradation and back-entered after the operation.

title: Cleaning validation boundary
scenario_summary: Campaign sequencing changed after a new high-potency product was introduced.

title: Process analytical technology drift
scenario_summary: A PAT model version changed without synchronized update to the batch record recipe.

title: Qualified Person evidence gap
scenario_summary: The EU release packet lacks confirmation of one contract-site audit commitment.

title: Audit-trail disabled
scenario_summary: A privileged account disabled audit capture for 47 minutes during master-data repair.

title: Shared laboratory account
scenario_summary: Three analysts used a shared instrument account during night shift.

title: Validation-state ambiguity
scenario_summary: The same application is labelled validated, conditionally released and research-only in three inventories.

title: Unapproved spreadsheet
scenario_summary: A macro-enabled spreadsheet calculates dissolution acceptance and has no verified version history.

title: CAPA effectiveness failure
scenario_summary: A recurring deviation reappears after CAPA closure with a different taxonomy code.

title: Change-control bypass
scenario_summary: A vendor hotfix was installed under emergency change but never retrospectively approved.

title: Record-retention conflict
scenario_summary: Legal hold, GxP retention and privacy deletion obligations point to different actions for the same records.

title: ALCOA+ provenance break
scenario_summary: A PDF certificate was manually transcribed; the original signed source cannot be located.

title: ICSR duplicate cluster
scenario_summary: Cases from a patient programme, literature vendor and call centre likely describe the same event under different product names.

title: Reporting-clock conflict
scenario_summary: Awareness date differs across vendor receipt, affiliate inbox and global safety database.

title: MedDRA version mismatch
scenario_summary: Coding was performed with two MedDRA versions, changing the preferred term and signal grouping.

title: Expectedness source conflict
scenario_summary: The investigator brochure, core data sheet and local label are not aligned.

title: Pregnancy and paediatric sensitivity
scenario_summary: A narrative includes pregnancy exposure and a minor’s data within a general case queue.

title: Social-media authenticity
scenario_summary: A high-severity post cannot be linked to an identifiable reporter or patient.

title: Product-quality and safety link
scenario_summary: A complaint about particles may relate to adverse events and a specific packaging lot.

title: Signal disproportionality instability
scenario_summary: A signal changes materially when duplicate suppression and exposure estimates are varied.

title: IDMP identity conflict
scenario_summary: Substance, strength and pharmaceutical-form codes differ across RIM, ERP and regional registrations.

title: Labeling divergence
scenario_summary: A risk statement is approved in the EU but pending in the US and absent in two distributor leaflets.

title: Commitment deadline ambiguity
scenario_summary: A post-authorisation commitment has conflicting due dates in authority correspondence and the tracking system.

title: eCTD sequence gap
scenario_summary: A submission index references a document not present in the archived sequence.

title: Variation classification dispute
scenario_summary: Regulatory teams disagree whether a manufacturing change is reportable before implementation.

title: Inspection request surge
scenario_summary: Regulators request traceable evidence spanning trial data, batch history, safety cases and AI-system controls within 72 hours.

title: Cold-chain lane excursion
scenario_summary: A biologic shipment exceeds range; logger clocks and pallet association are disputed.

title: Serialization aggregation break
scenario_summary: Case-to-pallet aggregation is missing after a line restart.

title: Counterfeit suspicion
scenario_summary: Two returned packs have valid-looking serials but inconsistent print and distribution history.

title: Critical excipient shortage
scenario_summary: A sole-source excipient supplier reports contamination and an eight-week recovery estimate.

title: CMO capacity conflict
scenario_summary: The CMO promises capacity to two sponsors during the same campaign window.

title: Allocation ethics
scenario_summary: Demand exceeds available stock across markets, trials and compassionate-use programmes.

title: Customs documentation mismatch
scenario_summary: Shipment product description differs from the import licence and invoice.

title: Recall-scope uncertainty
scenario_summary: Potentially affected lots share components, equipment and distribution routes but not all genealogy links are complete.

title: Genomic re-identification risk
scenario_summary: A rare-disease dataset is nominally pseudonymised but contains highly identifying combinations.

title: Cross-border secondary use
scenario_summary: EU trial data is proposed for global model training under a purpose not explicit in the original consent.

title: Data-subject request versus GxP record
scenario_summary: A participant requests deletion of data that may need preservation for trial integrity and legal obligations.

title: Patient-support programme leakage
scenario_summary: Free text contains diagnoses, financial hardship and family details beyond the stated purpose.

title: Research-commercial boundary
scenario_summary: Biomarker data licensed for research is being considered for commercial targeting.

title: Regional residency failure
scenario_summary: A backup replica places regulated personal data in an unapproved region.

title: Prompt injection in SOP
scenario_summary: A supplier deviation PDF includes hidden instructions asking the AI to ignore quality holds.

title: Tool-manifest poisoning
scenario_summary: A newly registered batch-status tool requests write access and silently changes a disposition field.

title: Entitlement revocation lag
scenario_summary: A contractor’s access was revoked in IAM but remains cached in the AI gateway.

title: Safety-data exfiltration
scenario_summary: A crafted query attempts to retrieve identifiable narratives across affiliates.

title: Ransomware and OT segmentation
scenario_summary: Manufacturing historians are isolated while MES and QMS operate in degraded mode.

title: Model supply-chain compromise
scenario_summary: A model package hash differs from the approved registry entry.

title: Automation bias in batch review
scenario_summary: Reviewers accept an AI summary despite an omitted critical deviation.

title: Language inequity
scenario_summary: Safety narratives in Arabic and Hindi have lower extraction quality than English and German.

title: Accessibility failure
scenario_summary: The proposed interface cannot be operated fully by keyboard and uses colour-only warnings.

title: Role conflict
scenario_summary: A global process owner wants uniform automation while local Qualified Persons and safety officers retain legal accountability.

title: Model price shock
scenario_summary: The preferred model vendor increases input-token price by 70% and reduces batch discounts.

title: Denial-of-wallet pattern
scenario_summary: Repeated oversized document submissions create abnormal inference and embedding spend.

title: Hidden human-review cost
scenario_summary: The business case excludes medical, Quality and regulatory review time.

title: Vendor concentration
scenario_summary: The same provider hosts the model, vector store, evaluation service and observability pipeline.

title: Regional platform outage
scenario_summary: The primary AI region fails during batch review and expedited safety reporting.

title: Checkpoint corruption
scenario_summary: An agent resumes a supply-recovery plan from stale state and duplicates draft reservations.

title: Model substitution regression
scenario_summary: A smaller fallback model preserves schema compliance but loses evidence fidelity in non-English cases.

title: AI-disabled continuity
scenario_summary: The organisation must operate safely for 14 days without any model inference.

title: Vendor exit deadline
scenario_summary: A strategic vendor will terminate service in 120 days and export formats are incomplete.

title: Retirement and evidence preservation
scenario_summary: The AI service may be retired, but prompts, model versions, decisions and validation evidence must remain inspectable.
